page.notes: The Greek word split at the line end ("ἐκεῖ-" / "νον") is a doubtful reading; the first part is marked [?]. The "V" below the last line, centred and not at the right, is a printer's mark or catchword-like sign, not transcribed as a catchword. The "II." and "Pearf." marks are margin notes; "c.2. p.15." is a reference beside the line. Printed ligature forms (Epistolas, Hisce) are rendered with ordinary letters.
